issues: No DefaultTransform: managedFields cached for all objects (wasted memory). Add cache.DefaultTransform to strip managedFields and reduce memory footprint
No GOMEMLIMIT set in deployment (Go GC cannot pressure-tune). Set GOMEMLIMIT to 80-90% of container memory limit for optimal GC behavior
Type HorizontalPodAutoscaler is watched but has no cache filter (cluster-wide informer)
Type InferencePool is watched but has no cache filter (cluster-wide informer)
Type ScaledObject is watched but has no cache filter (cluster-wide informer)

operator_config.name: Managed
operator_config.doc:
Managed is the annotation that opts a ScaledObject or HPA into WVA management.
Value must be "true".

operator_config.name: ModelID
operator_config.doc:
ModelID is the required annotation identifying the model served by the variant.
It maps to VariantAutoscalingSpec.ModelID and is used for multi-variant grouping.

operator_config.name: Synthetic
VariantCost
operator_config.doc:
VariantCost is the optional annotation specifying cost per replica for
cost-aware optimization. Must be a non-negative decimal string. Defaults to "10.0".

operator_config.name: defaultVariantCost
operator_config.doc: defaultVariantCost matches the kubebuilder default on VariantAutoscalingConfigSpec.

operator_config.name: agnosticReplicaQueries
operator_config.doc:
agnosticReplicaQueries are the logical query names collected per replica whose
metric source is engine-independent (the EPP inference scheduler). They are
refreshed once and shared across engines.

operator_config.name: defaultCacheSize
operator_config.doc:
defaultCacheSize is the size of the pod → top-level scale-target LRU.
One entry is roughly 100 B of strings + a chainNode value; 4096 entries
fit in well under a MB and cover typical clusters where the chain-node
universe is a small multiple of variant count.

operator_config.name: defaultMaxDepth
operator_config.doc:
defaultMaxDepth caps walkOwnersUp. Pod → ReplicaSet → Deployment → CR → wrapper-CR
is 5 hops in practice; 8 leaves slack while still bounding runaway chains.

operator_config.name: engineSpecificSet
QueryAvgITL
operator_config.doc:
QueryAvgITL is the query name for average inter-token latency per pod (in seconds).
Source: vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds histogram

operator_config.name: QueryAvgTTFT
operator_config.doc:
QueryAvgTTFT is the query name for average time-to-first-token per pod (in seconds).
Source: vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds histogram

operator_config.name: QuerySchedulerDispatchRate
operator_config.doc:
QuerySchedulerDispatchRate is the query name for per-endpoint request dispatch rate from scheduler.
This represents the arrival rate (requests/sec) being dispatched to each replica by the scheduler.
Source: inference_extension_scheduler_attempts_total (gateway-api-inference-extension)

operator_config.name: QueryCacheConfigInfo
operator_config.doc: V2 queries (token-based capacity analysis)

operator_config.name: QueryKvCacheUsage
operator_config.doc: Saturation queries (per-pod peak metrics over time windows)

operator_config.name: QuerySchedulerQueueSize
operator_config.doc: Scheduler flow control queries (model-level, from inference scheduler)

operator_config.name: ParamRetentionPeriod
operator_config.doc: ParamRetentionPeriod is the parameter name for the retention period duration.

operator_config.name: QueryModelRequestCount
operator_config.doc: QueryModelRequestCount is the query name for total model requests over a time window.

operator_config.name: QueryGenerationTokenRate
operator_config.doc:
QueryGenerationTokenRate is the query name for the observed generation
(decode) token rate per pod (tokens/sec).
This is the direct observable proxy for μ_dec^obs — how many tokens each
replica is currently generating per second.
Source: vllm:request_generation_tokens_sum (histogram _sum counter)

operator_config.name: QueryKvUsageInstant
operator_config.doc:
QueryKvUsageInstant is the query name for the instantaneous KV cache utilization
fraction per pod (0.0–1.0). Used as k* (current operating point) in the ITL
model: ITL(k) = A·k + B.

Same underlying metric as QueryKvCacheUsage (vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc), but
without max_over_time. QueryKvCacheUsage wraps the gauge in max_over_time[1m]
to give the saturation analyzer a conservative peak. This query reads the raw
gauge so the throughput analyzer sees the current operating point, not a
1-minute high-water mark that could overestimate load and trigger premature
scale-up after a transient spike.

max by (pod): deduplication only. vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc is a single scalar
gauge per vLLM process; there is one series per pod in normal deployment. The
max by (pod) collapses any duplicate series that arise when a pod is scraped by
multiple targets (e.g., PodMonitor + ServiceMonitor). Since duplicates carry the
same value, max = avg — the choice has no effect on correctness.
Source: vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc (gauge)

operator_config.name: QueryRequestRate
operator_config.doc:
QueryRequestRate is the query name for the engine-side request completion
rate per pod (req/s), derived from the generation tokens histogram count.
It is engine-agnostic: the vLLM variant reads
vllm:request_generation_tokens_count and the SGLang variant reads
sglang:generation_tokens_histogram_count.

Used as a fallback for λ_dec estimation when EPP/scheduler metrics are
unavailable (ArrivalRate == 0 for all pods). Per variant V, the analyzer computes:
  λ_dec_fallback = Σ_{r∈V}(RequestRate_r × AvgOutputTokens_r)

Note: measures completed requests (served demand), not arriving requests.
It undercounts when requests are queued in the scheduler. Use
ArrivalRate (via QuerySchedulerDispatchRate) as the primary demand source.

operator_config.name: QueryTypeMetricName
operator_config.doc:
QueryTypeMetricName is a simple metric name (e.g., "vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc").
Used for backends that don't support PromQL (pod-scrape, EPP).

operator_config.name: QueryTypePromQL
operator_config.doc:
QueryTypePromQL is a full PromQL expression with optional template parameters.
Only supported by the Prometheus backend.

operator_config.name: backslashPattern
operator_config.doc: Pre-compiled regex patterns for PromQL value escaping.

operator_config.name: LimiterTypeInventory
operator_config.doc:
LimiterTypeInventory builds the TypeInventory-backed limiter
(physical GPU discovery via the GPU operator). Default.

operator_config.name: LimiterTypeQuota
operator_config.doc:
LimiterTypeQuota builds one or more QuotaInventory-backed limiters
from an operator-supplied YAML file. Multiple entries are wrapped in
a CompositeLimiter that applies them sequentially.

operator_config.name: DefaultConfigMapName
operator_config.doc: DefaultConfigMapName is the default name of the ConfigMap containing autoscaler configuration

operator_config.name: DefaultNamespace
operator_config.doc: DefaultNamespace is the default namespace for the controller

operator_config.name: DefaultQMAnalyzerConfigMapName
operator_config.doc: DefaultQMAnalyzerConfigMapName is the default name of the ConfigMap for queueing model based scaling

operator_config.name: DefaultSaturationConfigMapName
operator_config.doc: DefaultSaturationConfigMapName is the default name of the ConfigMap for saturation scaling

operator_config.name: MaxQuotaValue
operator_config.doc:
MaxQuotaValue is the largest finite quota a single entry may declare. It is
far above any realistic GPU count (a million accelerators) and exists only to
keep the aggregate sum (summed across namespaces in aggregateNamespacePools)
well clear of int64 overflow — an overflowed sum could wrap negative and be
misread as the QuotaUnlimited (-1) sentinel.

operator_config.name: QuotaLimiterReservedNamespaceKey
operator_config.doc:
QuotaLimiterReservedNamespaceKey is the reserved key in the namespace-scoped
quotas map that matches any namespace not explicitly listed. A real namespace
named "default" cannot be configured directly via this key — list it in
`exclude` or use a strict allowlist instead.

operator_config.name: QuotaScopeCluster
operator_config.doc:
QuotaScopeCluster caps total GPUs of a given accelerator type across
all namespaces.

operator_config.name: QuotaScopeNamespace
operator_config.doc:
QuotaScopeNamespace caps GPUs of a given accelerator type within a
specific namespace, with optional fall-through via the reserved
`default` key.

operator_config.name: QuotaUnlimited
operator_config.doc:
QuotaUnlimited is the per-type quota value that disables the cap for that
accelerator type in the containing namespace. Follows the Kubernetes
convention of -1 = no limit (e.g., `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: -1`).

operator_config.name: DefaultPriority
operator_config.doc:
DefaultPriority is the default model priority multiplier.
Higher priority → preferential GPU allocation in fair-share.

operator_config.name: DefaultScaleToZeroConfigMapName
operator_config.doc:
DefaultScaleToZeroConfigMapName is the default name of the ConfigMap that stores
per-model scale-to-zero configuration.

operator_config.name: DefaultScaleToZeroRetentionPeriod
operator_config.doc:
DefaultScaleToZeroRetentionPeriod is the default time to wait after the last request
before scaling down to zero replicas. This default applies when scale-to-zero is enabled
but no explicit retention period is specified.

operator_config.name: GlobalDefaultsKey
operator_config.doc:
GlobalDefaultsKey is the key in the ConfigMap used to specify global defaults
for all models. Models can override these defaults with their specific configuration.
This follows the same pattern as saturation-scaling-config (deployed as wva-saturation-scaling-config).

operator_config.name: DefaultAcceleratorName
operator_config.doc:
DefaultAcceleratorName is used internally by the GPU limiter when the
accelerator type cannot be resolved from the scale target or VA label.
In homogeneous clusters (single GPU type), the limiter resolves this to
the real type before it reaches status or metrics. This value must never
be persisted to VA status or used as a Prometheus label.

operator_config.name: K8SEventScaledUp
operator_config.doc: K8s Events

operator_config.name: PrometheusQueryBackoff
operator_config.doc: Lightweight backoff for individual Prometheus queries (collector, etc.)

operator_config.name: PrometheusValidationBackoff
operator_config.doc:
Prometheus validation backoff with longer intervals
TODO: investigate why Prometheus needs longer backoff durations

operator_config.name: ReconcileBackoff
operator_config.doc: Slow backoff for operations that need more time

operator_config.name: ScaledObjectKind
operator_config.doc:
KEDA ScaledObject identity, used to recognize the HPA KEDA generates per
ScaledObject (the child HPA inherits the ScaledObject's annotations).

operator_config.name: StandardBackoff
operator_config.doc: Standard backoff for most operations

operator_config.name: UnresolvedAcceleratorType
operator_config.doc:
UnresolvedAcceleratorType is the bounded accelerator_type label value used
on the replica scaling gauges (wva_current_replicas / wva_desired_replicas /
wva_desired_ratio) when the real accelerator type is not yet known. Unlike
the internal DefaultAcceleratorName sentinel, this IS a valid label value:
it lets the scaling signal flow to HPA/KEDA without leaking "unknown" and
without withholding scaling. It is never persisted to VA status.

operator_config.name: AnnotationValueTrue
operator_config.doc: AnnotationValueTrue is the canonical string value for boolean annotations and labels.

operator_config.name: ControllerInstanceLabelKey
operator_config.doc:
ControllerInstanceLabelKey is the label key used to associate VAs with specific controller instances.
Used for multi-controller isolation where each controller only manages VAs with matching labels.

operator_config.name: NamespaceConfigEnabledLabelKey
operator_config.doc:
NamespaceConfigEnabledLabelKey is the label key used to opt-in namespaces for namespace-local ConfigMap overrides.
When a namespace has this label set to "true", the controller will watch for namespace-local ConfigMaps
even if no VariantAutoscaling resources exist in that namespace yet.
This enables creating namespace-local ConfigMaps before VAs are created, avoiding race conditions.

operator_config.name: NamespaceExcludeAnnotationKey
operator_config.doc:
NamespaceExcludeAnnotationKey is the annotation key used to exclude namespaces from WVA management.
When a namespace has this annotation set to "true", the controller will not watch it
for namespace-local ConfigMaps or reconcile VariantAutoscaling resources in it,
even if the namespace has VAs or opt-in labels.
This provides explicit control to exclude namespaces from WVA management.

operator_config.name: VariantLabelKey
operator_config.doc:
VariantLabelKey is the label key stamped on pod templates of managed workloads.
The value is set to the VariantAutoscaling resource name, enabling direct pod-to-VA mapping
without ownership traversal. This label is used by the metrics collector to filter pods
and associate them with their managing VariantAutoscaling resource.

operator_config.name: VariantLabelPrometheusKey
operator_config.doc:
VariantLabelPrometheusKey is the Prometheus metric label name for the variant label.
Kubernetes labels are sanitized for Prometheus: dots (.) and hyphens (-) become underscores (_).
"llm-d.ai/variant" → "__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_llm_d_ai_variant" → "llm_d_ai_variant".

operator_config.name: LabelUnit
operator_config.doc:
LabelUnit distinguishes the unit of a metric value when a single metric name
carries values with different semantic units. Applied to wva_required_capacity
and wva_spare_capacity, whose values are either a "binary" 0/1 signal (V1) or a
"continuous" token magnitude (V2).

operator_config.name: PodMappingMissUnresolved
operator_config.doc:
PodMappingMissUnresolved indicates a scraped pod resolved to no managed scaler —
no llm-d.ai/variant label and the locator found no owning HPA/ScaledObject.

operator_config.name: SGLangCachedTokensTotal
operator_config.doc:
SGLangCachedTokensTotal is a counter of prompt tokens served from the prefix cache.
Used with SGLangPromptTokensTotal to compute the prefix cache hit rate, the
unit-safe analog of vllm:prefix_cache_hits / vllm:prefix_cache_queries.

operator_config.name: SGLangGenerationTokensHistogramCount
operator_config.doc:
SGLangGenerationTokensHistogramCount is the count part of the generation-token histogram.
SGLang equivalent of vllm:request_generation_tokens_count.

operator_config.name: SGLangGenerationTokensHistogramSum
operator_config.doc:
SGLangGenerationTokensHistogramSum is the sum part of the generation-token histogram.
SGLang equivalent of vllm:request_generation_tokens_sum.

operator_config.name: SGLangInterTokenLatencySecondsCount
operator_config.doc:
SGLangInterTokenLatencySecondsCount is the count part of the inter-token-latency histogram.
SGLang equivalent of vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_count.

operator_config.name: SGLangInterTokenLatencySecondsSum
operator_config.doc:
SGLangInterTokenLatencySecondsSum is the sum part of the inter-token-latency histogram.
SGLang equivalent of vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_sum.

operator_config.name: SGLangMaxTotalNumTokens
operator_config.doc:
SGLangMaxTotalNumTokens is the total KV-cache token capacity (gauge).
SGLang exposes capacity directly, unlike vLLM which derives it from
vllm:cache_config_info (num_gpu_blocks x block_size).

operator_config.name: SGLangNumQueueReqs
operator_config.doc:
SGLangNumQueueReqs is the number of requests in the waiting queue (gauge).
SGLang equivalent of vllm:num_requests_waiting.

operator_config.name: SGLangNumRequestsTotal
operator_config.doc:
SGLangNumRequestsTotal is a counter of received requests.
SGLang equivalent of vllm:request_success_total (used for scale-to-zero).

operator_config.name: SGLangNumRunningReqs
operator_config.doc:
SGLangNumRunningReqs is the number of running requests (gauge).
SGLang equivalent of vllm:num_requests_running.

operator_config.name: SGLangPromptTokensHistogramCount
operator_config.doc:
SGLangPromptTokensHistogramCount is the count part of the prompt-token histogram.
SGLang equivalent of vllm:request_prompt_tokens_count.

operator_config.name: SGLangPromptTokensHistogramSum
operator_config.doc:
SGLangPromptTokensHistogramSum is the sum part of the prompt-token histogram.
SGLang equivalent of vllm:request_prompt_tokens_sum.

operator_config.name: SGLangPromptTokensTotal
operator_config.doc: SGLangPromptTokensTotal is a counter of total prompt tokens.

operator_config.name: SGLangTimeToFirstTokenSecondsCount
operator_config.doc:
SGLangTimeToFirstTokenSecondsCount is the count part of the TTFT histogram.
SGLang equivalent of vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_count.

operator_config.name: SGLangTimeToFirstTokenSecondsSum
operator_config.doc:
SGLangTimeToFirstTokenSecondsSum is the sum part of the TTFT histogram.
SGLang equivalent of vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_sum.

operator_config.name: SGLangTokenUsage
operator_config.doc:
SGLangTokenUsage is the KV-cache token-pool utilization as a fraction 0.0-1.0 (gauge).
SGLang equivalent of vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc.

operator_config.name: SchedulerFlowControlQueueBytes
operator_config.doc:
SchedulerFlowControlQueueBytes is the total bytes of request bodies queued
in the inference scheduler's flow control layer.
Labels: fairness_id, priority, inference_pool, model_name, target_model_name
Note: no namespace label — see TODO(#2309) above.

operator_config.name: SchedulerFlowControlQueueSize
operator_config.doc:
SchedulerFlowControlQueueSize is the number of requests queued in the
inference scheduler's flow control layer.
Labels: fairness_id, priority, inference_pool, model_name, target_model_name
Note: no namespace label — see TODO(#2309) above.

operator_config.name: VLLMCacheConfigInfo
operator_config.doc:
VLLMCacheConfigInfo is an info-style gauge that exposes KV cache configuration as labels.
Labels include num_gpu_blocks, block_size, cache_dtype, etc.
Value is always 1.0. Used by Saturation Analyzer V2 for token capacity computation.

operator_config.name: VLLMKvCacheUsagePerc
operator_config.doc:
VLLMKvCacheUsagePerc tracks the KV cache utilization as a percentage (0.0-1.0).
Used by saturation analyzer to detect KV cache saturation and prevent OOM errors.

operator_config.name: VLLMNumRequestRunning
operator_config.doc:
VLLMNumRequestRunning tracks the current number of running requests.
Used to validate metrics availability.

operator_config.name: VLLMNumRequestsWaiting
operator_config.doc:
VLLMNumRequestsWaiting tracks the number of requests waiting in the queue.
Used by saturation analyzer to detect request queue saturation.

operator_config.name: VLLMPrefixCacheHits
operator_config.doc:
VLLMPrefixCacheHits is a counter of prefix cache block hits.
Used with VLLMPrefixCacheQueries to compute prefix cache hit rate.

operator_config.name: VLLMPrefixCacheQueries
operator_config.doc:
VLLMPrefixCacheQueries is a counter of prefix cache block queries.
Used with VLLMPrefixCacheHits to compute prefix cache hit rate.

operator_config.name: VLLMRequestGenerationTokensCount
operator_config.doc:
VLLMRequestGenerationTokensCount tracks the count of requests for token generation.
Used with VLLMRequestGenerationTokensSum to calculate average output tokens.

operator_config.name: VLLMRequestGenerationTokensSum
operator_config.doc:
VLLMRequestGenerationTokensSum tracks the sum of generated tokens across all requests.
Used with VLLMRequestGenerationTokensCount to calculate average output tokens.

operator_config.name: VLLMRequestPromptTokensCount
operator_config.doc:
VLLMRequestPromptTokensCount tracks the count of requests for token generation.
Used with VLLMRequestPromptTokensSum to calculate average output tokens.

operator_config.name: VLLMRequestPromptTokensSum
operator_config.doc:
VLLMRequestPromptTokensSum tracks the sum of prompt tokens across all requests.
Used with VLLMRequestPromptTokensCount to calculate average output tokens.

operator_config.name: VLLMRequestSuccessTotal
operator_config.doc:
VLLMRequestSuccessTotal tracks the total number of successful requests.
Used to calculate arrival rate.

operator_config.name: VLLMTimePerOutputTokenSecondsCount
operator_config.doc:
VLLMTimePerOutputTokenSecondsCount tracks the count of requests for time per output token.
Used with VLLMTimePerOutputTokenSecondsSum to calculate ITL (Inter-Token Latency).

operator_config.name: VLLMTimePerOutputTokenSecondsSum
operator_config.doc:
VLLMTimePerOutputTokenSecondsSum tracks the sum of time per output token across all requests.
Used with VLLMTimePerOutputTokenSecondsCount to calculate ITL (Inter-Token Latency).

operator_config.name: VLLMTimeToFirstTokenSecondsCount
operator_config.doc:
VLLMTimeToFirstTokenSecondsCount tracks the count of requests for TTFT.
Used with VLLMTimeToFirstTokenSecondsSum to calculate TTFT.

operator_config.name: VLLMTimeToFirstTokenSecondsSum
operator_config.doc:
VLLMTimeToFirstTokenSecondsSum tracks the sum of TTFT (Time To First Token) across all requests.
Used with VLLMTimeToFirstTokenSecondsCount to calculate TTFT.

operator_config.name: WVAAvailableGpus
operator_config.doc:
WVAAvailableGpus is a gauge that tracks the number of currently available GPUs. If wva_gpu_discovery_up is 1, it shows
the number of currently available GPUs. If wva_gpu_discovery_up is 0, it shows the number
of GPUs that were available at the last successful discovery.
Labels: accelerator_type

operator_config.name: WVAConfigInfo
operator_config.doc:
WVAConfigInfo is an info-style gauge that exposes WVA configuration as labels.
Labels: analyzer_name, limiter_enabled, scale_to_zero_enabled

operator_config.name: WVAConfigKvSpareThreshold
operator_config.doc: WVAConfigKvSpareThreshold is a gauge that tracks the KV cache spare threshold configuration.

operator_config.name: WVAConfigOptimizationIntervalSeconds
operator_config.doc: WVAConfigOptimizationIntervalSeconds is a gauge that tracks the optimization interval in seconds.

operator_config.name: WVAConfigQueueSpareThreshold
operator_config.doc: WVAConfigQueueSpareThreshold is a gauge that tracks the queue spare threshold configuration.

operator_config.name: WVACurrentReplicas
operator_config.doc:
WVACurrentReplicas is a gauge that tracks the current number of replicas.
Labels: variant_name, namespace, accelerator_type

operator_config.name: WVADecisionsLimitedTotal
operator_config.doc:
WVADecisionsLimitedTotal is a counter that tracks the total number of decisions limited by the limiter.
Labels: variant_name, namespace, limiter_name

operator_config.name: WVADesiredRatio
operator_config.doc:
WVADesiredRatio is a gauge that tracks the ratio of desired to current replicas.
Labels: variant_name, namespace, accelerator_type

operator_config.name: WVADesiredReplicas
operator_config.doc:
WVADesiredReplicas is a gauge that tracks the desired number of replicas.
Labels: variant_name, namespace, accelerator_type

operator_config.name: WVAEnforcerModificationsTotal
operator_config.doc:
WVAEnforcerModificationsTotal is a counter that tracks the total number of decision modifications made by the enforcer.
Labels: policy_type

operator_config.name: WVAErrorsTotal
operator_config.doc:
WVAErrorsTotal is a counter that tracks the total number of errors by component.
Labels: component, error_type

operator_config.name: WVAGpuDiscoveryUp
operator_config.doc: WVAGpuDiscoveryUp is a gauge that indicates whether GPU discovery is on or off.

operator_config.name: WVAKvCacheTokensCapacity
operator_config.doc:
WVAKvCacheTokensCapacity is a gauge that tracks total KV cache token capacity per variant.
Labels: variant_name, namespace, model_name

operator_config.name: WVAKvCacheTokensUsed
operator_config.doc:
WVAKvCacheTokensUsed is a gauge that tracks total KV cache tokens currently in use per variant.
Labels: variant_name, namespace, model_name

operator_config.name: WVAMetricsCollectionDurationSeconds
operator_config.doc:
WVAMetricsCollectionDurationSeconds is a histogram that tracks the duration of metrics collection operations.
Labels: query_type

operator_config.name: WVAMetricsCollectionErrorsTotal
operator_config.doc:
WVAMetricsCollectionErrorsTotal is a counter that tracks the total number of metrics collection errors.
Labels: query_type, reason

operator_config.name: WVAMetricsFreshnessStatus
operator_config.doc:
WVAMetricsFreshnessStatus is a gauge that tracks the freshness status of metrics for each variant.
Labels: variant_name, status

operator_config.name: WVAMetricsPodsDiscovered
operator_config.doc:
WVAMetricsPodsDiscovered is a gauge that tracks the number of pods discovered for metrics collection.
Labels: namespace

operator_config.name: WVAModelsProcessed
operator_config.doc: WVAModelsProcessed is a gauge that tracks the number of models processed in the last optimization cycle.

operator_config.name: WVAOptimizationDurationSeconds
operator_config.doc:
WVAOptimizationDurationSeconds is a histogram that tracks the duration of each optimization cycle.
Labels: status (success, error)

operator_config.name: WVAOptimizerActive
operator_config.doc:
WVAOptimizerActive is a gauge that is 0 when an optimizer is inactive, and 1 when it's active.
Labels: optimizer_name

operator_config.name: WVAPodMappingMissTotal
operator_config.doc:
WVAPodMappingMissTotal is a counter that tracks pods whose metrics could not be
attributed to a managed scaler (neither the llm-d.ai/variant label nor the
pod locator resolved them). Makes the otherwise-silent skip visible.
Labels: namespace, reason

operator_config.name: WVAReplicaScalingTotal
operator_config.doc:
WVAReplicaScalingTotal is a counter that tracks the total number of scaling operations.
Labels: variant_name, namespace, direction (up/down), reason, accelerator_type

operator_config.name: WVARequiredCapacity
operator_config.doc:
WVARequiredCapacity is a gauge that tracks required capacity; >0 means scale-up
needed (per-role for P/D-disaggregated models, model-level otherwise).
Value semantics differ by analyzer (use the "unit" label to distinguish):
  - unit="continuous" (Token-based analyzer):       token demand
  - unit="binary"     (Percentage-based analyzer): 0.0 = no scale-up, 1.0 = scale-up
Labels: variant_name, namespace, model_name, unit

operator_config.name: WVASaturationMetricsUp
operator_config.doc:
WVASaturationMetricsUp is a per-VA freshness signal for the five
saturation/capacity gauges above. Set to 1.0 in cycles where the
optimizer produced a fresh decision for the variant (i.e. the other
gauges were just refreshed), and 0.0 in cycles where the analyzer was
aware of the variant but no fresh decision was emitted. Lets
dashboards distinguish "the system says utilization is X" from "the
system has not updated utilization in N minutes and X is the stalest
sample" without relying on Prometheus' 5-minute staleness marker.
Labels: variant_name, namespace

operator_config.name: WVASaturationUtilization
operator_config.doc:
WVASaturationUtilization is a gauge that tracks per-variant utilization ratio (0.0-1.0).
Labels: variant_name, namespace, model_name, accelerator_type

operator_config.name: WVASpareCapacity
operator_config.doc:
WVASpareCapacity is a gauge that tracks spare capacity; >0 means scale-down
headroom (per-role for P/D-disaggregated models, model-level otherwise).
Value semantics differ by analyzer (use the "unit" label to distinguish):
  - unit="continuous" (Token-based analyzer):       token surplus
  - unit="" (empty)   (Percentage-based analyzer): 0.0-1.0 threshold-relative fraction
Labels: variant_name, namespace, model_name, unit

operator_config.name: HPAByScaleTargetKey
operator_config.doc:
HPAByScaleTargetKey indexes managed HorizontalPodAutoscalers by their
spec.scaleTargetRef. Index value: scaleTargetIndexKey(namespace, ref).

operator_config.name: ScaledObjectByScaleTargetKey
operator_config.doc:
ScaledObjectByScaleTargetKey indexes managed KEDA ScaledObjects by their
spec.scaleTargetRef. Index value: scaleTargetIndexKey(namespace, ref).

operator_config.name: DefaultInterval
operator_config.doc: DefaultInterval is the default Coordinator loop interval.

operator_config.name: ErrPoolNotSynced
operator_config.doc: ErrPoolNotSynced is returned when an EndpointPool is not found in the datastore

operator_config.name: errPoolIsNull
operator_config.value: errors.New("EndpointPool object is nil, does not exist")

operator_config.doc: Ensure K8sWithGpuOperator implements FullDiscovery

operator_config.name: DefaultFallbackHeadroom
operator_config.doc:
DefaultFallbackHeadroom is the multiplier applied to observed latencies
when learned parameters are unavailable and we fall back to observations.

operator_config.name: DefaultMaxFallbackITL
operator_config.doc: DefaultMaxFallbackITL caps the observation-based fallback ITL SLO (ms).

operator_config.name: DefaultMaxFallbackTTFT
operator_config.doc: DefaultMaxFallbackTTFT caps the observation-based fallback TTFT SLO (ms).

operator_config.name: DefaultSLOMultiplier
operator_config.doc:
DefaultSLOMultiplier is the queueing delay multiplier for inferred SLOs.
The SLO allows iteration time (queueing delay) to inflate by k× the idle
baseline α, while keeping deterministic work components at their true cost.
k=3 corresponds to utilization ρ = 1 - 1/k = 0.67.

operator_config.name: TuningByAggregatingPodsForVariant
operator_config.doc:
TuningByAggregatingPodsForVariant is a selection switch used when
tuning the queueing model for a variant.
true: run the tuner once for an aggregate server of all pods
false: run the tuner for all pods of the variant

operator_config.name: BaseFactor
operator_config.doc: Initial parameter estimation factors

operator_config.name: DefaultAlpha
operator_config.doc: default parameter values (state vector)

operator_config.name: DefaultEpsilon
operator_config.doc: infinitesimal value to check float equality

operator_config.name: DefaultErrorLevel
operator_config.doc:
DefaultErrorLevel,  DefaultTPercentile along with DefaultGammaFactor is used in initializing the measurement noise covariance matrix R.
		Particularly, R is assumed to be diagonal, meaning measurement errors are independent across different measures ($z_i$).
		The measurement of a performance metric of interest, say z_i, is expected to have a 95% Confidence Interval (CI) of +-5% of its mean value.
		This means that the error (standard deviation) around z_i is expected to be 5% (DefaultErrorLevel).
		However, we assume that the measurement noise (error) follows a t-distribution.
		Under the asymptotic limit, the t-distribution converges to a standard normal distribution, the critical value of which is 1.96 (DefaultTPercentile).

operator_config.name: DefaultExpectedTTFT
operator_config.doc: default expected observation values

operator_config.name: DefaultGammaFactor
operator_config.doc: scaling factor used to adjust the calculated measurement noise variance (> 0).

operator_config.name: DefaultMaxNIS
operator_config.doc:
Under nominal conditions, the NIS (Normalized Innovations Squared) of a Kalman Filter is expected to follow
		a Chi-Squared Distribution with degrees of freedom equal to the dimension of the measurement vector (n = 2 for [ttft, itl]).
		Here, we enforce that a tuner update is accepted for 95% confidence interval of NIS.
		The upper bound of the interval in our case is 7.378.

operator_config.name: DefaultMinStateFactor
operator_config.doc: default min and max state factors determine the lower and upper bound on the state values.

operator_config.name: DefaultPercentChange
operator_config.doc: determines the limit on the amount of change in a state value per iteration. A small number results in the filter converging relatively slowly.

operator_config.name: StateIndexAlpha
operator_config.doc: State vector indices for model parameters

operator_config.name: TransientDelaySeconds
operator_config.doc: Transient delay to allow scaled up servers to start serving requests before tuning is applied

operator_config.name: BytesPerToken
operator_config.doc:
BytesPerToken is the approximate number of bytes per LLM token.
Used to convert scheduler queue bytes to estimated token count.
Based on the OpenAI tiktoken observation that each token corresponds
to roughly 4 bytes of text. This is conservative (yields an upper
bound on token count) since modern tokenizers achieve 5-6 chars/token.

operator_config.name: CapacityEvictionTimeout
operator_config.doc:
CapacityEvictionTimeout is the duration after which unused capacity
store records are eligible for removal. This is intentionally long
because historical capacity knowledge is valuable for zero-replica
estimation and cross-variant matching (e.g., a variant may be at
zero replicas over a weekend and scale back up Monday).

operator_config.name: CapacityStalenessTimeout
operator_config.doc:
CapacityStalenessTimeout is the duration after which a stored capacity
record is considered stale and should be refreshed from live data.

operator_config.name: HistoryEvictionTimeout
operator_config.doc:
HistoryEvictionTimeout is the duration after which unused k2 history
entries are eligible for removal. Shorter than capacity eviction
because workload patterns shift and stale k2 observations from a
very different workload can mislead scaling decisions.

operator_config.name: MediumOutputThreshold
operator_config.doc:
MediumOutputThreshold is the upper bound (exclusive) for the "medium"
output-length bucket used for k2 history keying.

operator_config.name: RollingAverageWindowSize
operator_config.doc:
RollingAverageWindowSize is the number of samples retained for compute
capacity (k2) history per workload bucket.

operator_config.name: ShortOutputThreshold
operator_config.doc:
ShortOutputThreshold is the upper bound (exclusive) for the "short"
output-length bucket used for k2 history keying.

operator_config.name: learnedFromLive
operator_config.doc: learnedFromLive indicates a capacity record was derived from live metrics.

operator_config.name: AnalyzerName
operator_config.doc: AnalyzerName is the canonical name for the throughput analyzer.

operator_config.name: DefaultBaselineITLSec
operator_config.doc:
DefaultBaselineITLSec is the hardware baseline inter-token latency (seconds/token)
used in tier-2 estimation when the OLS window is not yet ready.
Derived from H100 SXM5 measurements at near-zero KV load; workload-independent.

operator_config.name: DefaultGPSMinKForVerification
operator_config.doc:
DefaultGPSMinKForVerification is the minimum KV utilization (k*) required before
GPS verification is applied. Below this threshold the in-flight count N_dec is
small and percentage errors on GPS are unreliable.

operator_config.name: DefaultGPSMismatchClearThreshold
operator_config.doc:
DefaultGPSMismatchClearThreshold is the number of consecutive reconcile cycles
with a GPS mismatch before the observation window is cleared for recalibration.
Requiring N consecutive mismatches filters transient GPS noise while still
breaking persistent calibration lock. The counter resets to zero whenever the
window is cleared (shape change or threshold reached) so it is always bound to
the current window's lifetime.

operator_config.name: DefaultGPSMismatchThresholdPct
operator_config.doc:
DefaultGPSMismatchThresholdPct is the maximum tolerable percentage error between
the model-predicted decode rate μ_dec(k*) and the directly observed GPS
(GenerationTokenRate). Errors above this threshold at k* ≥ DefaultGPSMinKForVerification
indicate the ITL model may be wrong and trigger SpareCapacity suppression.

operator_config.name: DefaultKSat
operator_config.doc:
DefaultKSat is the KV utilization fraction at which per-replica capacity is
evaluated. Mirrors DefaultScaleUpThreshold in saturation config so that the
throughput analyzer and saturation analyzer agree on the definition of "full".
TODO: unify with the system-wide k_sat used by the EPP and saturation analyzer.

operator_config.name: DefaultMaxObservableK
operator_config.doc:
DefaultMaxObservableK is the upper bound on KV utilization for accepted
observations. Above this threshold the system approaches saturation and
the linear ITL model may no longer hold.

operator_config.name: DefaultMinDecodeOLForLocalDemand
operator_config.doc:
DefaultMinDecodeOLForLocalDemand is the minimum AvgOutputTokens required
before the k*-based local demand estimator is applied. The estimator derives
λ_dec = N_dec(k*) / ITL(k*) where N_dec is approximated from KV utilization
as k* × KV_max / KVreq. This approximation only holds in the decode-dominated
regime (N_pre ≈ 1, TA-supply.md §3.1), which requires sufficiently long OL.
When OL ≈ 0, KV usage is from prefill rather than decode; the formula then
produces spurious non-zero demand instead of the correct λ_dec = 0.

operator_config.name: DefaultMinKSpread
operator_config.doc:
DefaultMinKSpread is the minimum required spread (max_k - min_k) across
observations in the window before the window is considered Ready.
A spread of at least 0.30 ensures the linear fit spans a meaningful
portion of the KV utilization range and is not extrapolating from a
single operating point.

operator_config.name: DefaultMinObservableK
operator_config.doc:
DefaultMinObservableK is the lower bound on KV utilization for accepted
observations. Below this threshold the ITL signal is noisy (few
concurrent requests, high variance) and unreliable for fitting.

operator_config.name: DefaultMinSamples
operator_config.doc:
DefaultMinSamples is the minimum number of valid observations required
before the window is considered Ready for OLS fitting.

operator_config.name: DefaultMinTokensPerRequest
operator_config.doc:
DefaultMinTokensPerRequest is the minimum plausible value for AvgOutputTokens
or AvgInputTokens. Values at or below this threshold indicate the metric
is unavailable or zero-padded and are flagged as a sanity issue.

operator_config.name: DefaultNearKSatITLResidualThreshold
operator_config.doc:
DefaultNearKSatITLResidualThreshold is the fractional ITL residual above which
the observed AvgITL is considered inconsistent with the ITL model near k_sat.
A large residual points to bad data points or model drift.

operator_config.name: DefaultNearKSatMargin
operator_config.doc:
DefaultNearKSatMargin is the margin below DefaultKSat at which a replica is
considered "near saturation" for GPS sanity diagnostics. At k* above
DefaultKSat - DefaultNearKSatMargin the GPS signal is near-oracle quality:
any model–GPS discrepancy is a strong indicator of a model error.

operator_config.name: DefaultNearKSatNDecResidualThreshold
operator_config.doc:
DefaultNearKSatNDecResidualThreshold is the fractional N_dec cross-check threshold
used in near-k_sat GPS sanity. If ITL residual is small but GPS × AvgITL disagrees
with KV-derived N_dec, the workload shape (KVreq via IL, OL, or hit rate) may be wrong.

operator_config.name: DefaultObservationMaxAge
operator_config.doc:
DefaultObservationMaxAge is the maximum age of an observation in the
window. Observations older than this are pruned regardless of window
fullness, ensuring that stale data from a previous load pattern does
not contaminate the current fit.

operator_config.name: DefaultQueueDrainFactor
operator_config.doc:
DefaultQueueDrainFactor controls how aggressively queued requests count as
decode demand. The assumed drain time is QueueDrainFactor × ITL(k_sat) × avgOL;
after avgOL cancels, queue demand = QueueSize / (QueueDrainFactor × ITL(k_sat)).
A factor of 2.0 bounds per-request queueing time to ≤ 2 × ITL(k_sat) × avgOL.

operator_config.name: DefaultShapeChangeTolerance
operator_config.doc:
DefaultShapeChangeTolerance is the fractional change in IL or OL that
triggers a shape bucket change, clearing the observation window and
scheduling a new ITL model fit.
A value of 0.20 means a 20% shift in either dimension resets calibration.

operator_config.name: DefaultWindowMaxSize
operator_config.doc:
DefaultWindowMaxSize is the maximum number of (k, ITL) observations
retained in the rolling window. When the window is full, the oldest
observation is evicted on each new Add call.

operator_config.name: itlReasonT1OLS
operator_config.doc:
itlReason* are the values set on VariantCapacity.Reason by resolveITLModel.
They appear in the "analyzer-result" structured log line.

operator_config.name: itlSlopeEpsilon
operator_config.doc:
itlSlopeEpsilon is the smallest slope A that counts as meaningfully positive.
A perfectly flat fit is mathematically A == 0 but OLS rounding leaves noise of
order 1e-17; real slopes in this domain are order 1e-2. This threshold sits far
above the noise floor and far below any genuine slope.

operator_config.name: SanityIssueITLNonPositive
operator_config.doc:
SanityIssueITLNonPositive indicates AvgITL is zero, negative, or NaN.
This prevents adding any (k, ITL) observations from affected pods.

operator_config.name: SanityIssueKVOutOfRange
operator_config.doc: SanityIssueKVOutOfRange indicates KvUsageInstant (k*) is outside [0, 1].

operator_config.name: SanityIssueMissingKV
operator_config.doc:
SanityIssueMissingKV indicates TotalKvCapacityTokens is zero or negative,
meaning the KV cache configuration metric (cache_config_info) is unavailable.

operator_config.name: SanityIssueMissingShape
operator_config.doc:
SanityIssueMissingShape indicates AvgOutputTokens or AvgInputTokens is
at or below DefaultMinTokensPerRequest, making shape tracking unreliable.

operator_config.name: SanityIssueNoReplicas
operator_config.doc: SanityIssueNoReplicas indicates the model has no replica metrics at all.

operator_config.name: SanityIssueStaleMetrics
operator_config.doc:
SanityIssueStaleMetrics indicates the replica's metrics are marked stale
(Metadata.FreshnessStatus == "stale"). Stale data should not be used
for calibration.

operator_config.name: DecisionCache
operator_config.doc: Global cache instance

operator_config.name: DecisionTrigger
operator_config.doc:
DecisionTrigger is a channel to trigger reconciliation for VAs.
Buffered to prevent blocking the engine loop.
Ensure CompositeLimiter implements Limiter.
Ensure CostAwareOptimizer implements ScalingOptimizer
Ensure DefaultLimiter implements Limiter interface
Ensure GreedyBySaturation implements AllocationAlgorithm interface
Ensure GreedyByScoreOptimizer implements ScalingOptimizer
Ensure NoOpLimiter implements Limiter.
Ensure TypeInventory implements Inventory interface

operator_config.name: MetricsMessageAvailable
operator_config.value: Scaled from zero due to pending requests

operator_config.name: EngineSGLang
operator_config.doc: EngineSGLang is the SGLang inference engine.

operator_config.name: EngineVLLM
operator_config.doc:
EngineVLLM is the vLLM inference engine. It is the default when no other
engine is detected, so existing deployments are unaffected.

operator_config.name: QueueingModelAnalyzerName
operator_config.doc: QueueingModelAnalyzerName is the canonical name for the queueing model analyzer.

operator_config.name: DecisionReasonSaturationOnly
operator_config.doc: DecisionReasonSaturationOnly indicates decision from saturation-only mode.

operator_config.name: DecisionReasonScaleFromZero
operator_config.doc: DecisionReasonScaleFromZero indicates scale-up from zero replicas.

operator_config.name: DecisionReasonTest
operator_config.doc: DecisionReasonTest is used for test scenarios.

operator_config.name: DecisionReasonV2
operator_config.doc: DecisionReasonV2 indicates a V2 pipeline decision.

operator_config.name: RoleBoth
operator_config.doc: RoleBoth represents the default role when a variant serves both prefill and decode.

operator_config.name: RolePrefill
operator_config.doc: RolePrefill represents the prefill-only role in a P/D disaggregated deployment.

operator_config.name: SaturationAnalyzerName
operator_config.doc: SaturationAnalyzerName is the canonical name for the saturation analyzer.

operator_config.name: ControllerInstanceEnvVar
operator_config.doc: ControllerInstanceEnvVar is the environment variable name for controller instance label

operator_config.name: DefaultVariantCost
operator_config.doc:
DefaultVariantCost is the fallback cost used when variant cost is not specified
in the VariantAutoscaling CR. This should match the cost of the cheapest accelerator
to avoid biasing decisions toward unknown-cost variants.

operator_config.name: MinNonSaturatedReplicasForScaleDown
operator_config.doc:
MinNonSaturatedReplicasForScaleDown is the minimum number of non-saturated replicas
required before scale-down is considered safe. With fewer replicas, the system
cannot safely redistribute load without risking saturation.

operator_config.name: PoolGroupV1
operator_config.doc: Valid InferencePool API groups

operator_config.name: AcceleratorNameLabel
operator_config.doc: AcceleratorNameLabel is the label key used to specify the accelerator name for a VA.

operator_config.name: AddToScheme
operator_config.doc:
AddToScheme adds the VariantAutoscaling types to the given scheme. Intended for
test fake clients only — see GroupVersion.

operator_config.name: GroupVersion
operator_config.doc:
GroupVersion identifies the (historical) VariantAutoscaling group/version.

VariantAutoscaling is no longer a served CRD; it exists only as an in-memory
type synthesized from annotated HPAs/ScaledObjects. GroupVersion and AddToScheme
are retained solely so unit tests can register the type with a controller-runtime
fake client, which requires every object it stores to be scheme-registered. The
production manager scheme (cmd/main.go) does NOT register these types.

operator_config.name: SchemeBuilder
operator_config.doc: SchemeBuilder registers the VariantAutoscaling types with a runtime.Scheme.

operator_config.name: MessageMetricsAvailable
operator_config.value: Saturation metrics data is available for scaling decisions
operator_config.doc: MessageMetricsAvailable indicates metrics are available for scaling decisions

operator_config.name: MessageMetricsUnavailable
operator_config.value: No saturation metrics available - pods may not be ready or metrics not yet scraped
operator_config.doc: MessageMetricsUnavailable indicates metrics are not available

operator_config.name: ReasonInvalidConfiguration
operator_config.doc: ReasonInvalidConfiguration indicates VA has invalid configuration (e.g., missing ModelID)

operator_config.name: ReasonMetricsFound
operator_config.doc: ReasonMetricsFound indicates vLLM metrics were successfully retrieved

operator_config.name: ReasonMetricsMissing
operator_config.doc: ReasonMetricsMissing indicates vLLM metrics are not available (likely ServiceMonitor issue)

operator_config.name: ReasonMetricsStale
operator_config.doc: ReasonMetricsStale indicates metrics exist but are outdated

operator_config.name: ReasonMetricsUnavailable
operator_config.doc: ReasonMetricsUnavailable indicates optimization cannot run due to missing metrics

operator_config.name: ReasonOptimizationFailed
operator_config.doc: ReasonOptimizationFailed indicates optimization failed

operator_config.name: ReasonOptimizationSucceeded
operator_config.doc: ReasonOptimizationSucceeded indicates optimization completed successfully

operator_config.name: ReasonPrometheusError
operator_config.doc: ReasonPrometheusError indicates error querying Prometheus

operator_config.name: ReasonSkippedProcessing
operator_config.doc: ReasonSkippedProcessing indicates VA was skipped during processing

operator_config.name: ReasonTargetFound
operator_config.doc: ReasonTargetFound indicates the scale target was successfully resolved

operator_config.name: ReasonTargetNotFound
operator_config.doc: ReasonTargetNotFound indicates the scale target could not be found

operator_config.name: TypeMetricsAvailable
operator_config.doc: TypeMetricsAvailable indicates whether vLLM metrics are available from Prometheus

operator_config.name: TypeOptimizationReady
operator_config.doc: TypeOptimizationReady indicates whether the optimization engine can run successfully

operator_config.name: TypeTargetResolved
operator_config.doc: TypeTargetResolved indicates whether the target model variant has been resolved successfully

operator_config.name: DefaultMaxNumTokens
operator_config.doc: maximum number of tokens per batch (iteration)

operator_config.name: Epsilon
operator_config.doc: small disturbance around a value

operator_config.name: StabilitySafetyFraction
operator_config.doc: fraction of maximum server throughput to provide stability (running this fraction below the maximum)

operator_config.name: AccelPenaltyFactor
operator_config.doc: accelerator transition penalty factor

operator_config.name: DefaultHighPriority
operator_config.doc: default priority of a highest service class

operator_config.name: DefaultLowPriority
operator_config.doc: default priority of a lowest service class

operator_config.name: DefaultSaturatedAllocationPolicy
operator_config.doc: default option for allocation under saturated condition

operator_config.name: DefaultServiceClassName
operator_config.doc: default name of a service class

operator_config.name: DefaultServiceClassPriority
operator_config.doc: default priority of a service class (lowest)

operator_config.name: MaxQueueToBatchRatio
operator_config.doc: maximum number of requests in queueing system as multiples of maximum batch size

operator_config.name: SLOMargin
operator_config.doc: Multiplier of average of exponential distribution to attain percentile

operator_config.name: SLOPercentile
operator_config.doc: Tolerated percentile for SLOs
